rules.key: may opt to include the direct influence of the Hive Mind in lieu of having a fleet commander
rules.text: The Tyranid player may opt to include the direct influence of the Hive Mind in lieu of having a fleet commander.
rules.why: Explains why the FLEET COMMANDER section has no commander but two purchasable effects.

rules.key: A maximum of one Hive Mind Influence re-roll can be purchased per hive ship
rules.text: A maximum of one Hive Mind Influence re-roll can be purchased per hive ship in the fleet.
rules.why: Enforced 9.9.2026 (item 8): the rule read from the book was added to build_data.py's RULE_PICKS table; resolveFleet checks it. upgrade_ratio: the units that took the upgrade per hive ship. The earlier gap: a ratio whose NUMERATOR is an upgrade row and not a ship. The engine counts ratios from the sections' ship counts, so this could not be expressed.

rules.key: A maximum of one Hive Mind Imperative can be purchased per two hive ships
rules.text: A maximum of one Hive Mind Imperative can be purchased per two hive ships in the fleet, though a single Hive Mind Imperative may be purchased as long as the fleet contains at least one hive ship.
rules.why: Enforced 9.9.2026 (item 8): the rule read from the book was added to build_data.py's RULE_PICKS table; resolveFleet checks it. upgrade_ratio min_one: one is allowed already with one hive ship. The earlier gap: the same reason, and the sentence also contains an exception: one may be bought already with one hive ship.

rules.key: Each hive ship allows the Tyranid player to purchase
rules.text: Each hive ship allows the Tyranid player to purchase 6-18 escort ships and 0-2 capital ships.
rules.why: Two rules in one sentence. The hull ships' side is enforced from the next page's sentence ('up to 2 capital ships for each hive ship'); the escorts' 6-12 is not.

rules.key: up to 2 capital ships for each hive ship
rules.text: You may include up to 2 capital ships for each hive ship in the fleet.
rules.why: Parsed only when the ratio pattern was taught to know 'for each' alongside the word pair 'for every' (7.9.2026).

rules.key: between 0 and 12 additional escort class ships
rules.text: You may include between 0 and 12 additional escort class ships (of any kind) for each hive ship.
rules.why: Updated for Fleets v0.40 on 29.10.2026: with the six escort drones per hive ship, at most 18 escorts per hive ship (p.430: 'purchase 6-18 escort ships'); ratio 18 per hive ship, when a hive ship is chosen. v0.36 said 'between 6 and 12 escort class ships'.

rules.key: If no hive ships are chosen, only Kraken and Vanguard drone ships may be included
rules.text: If no hive ships are chosen, only Kraken and Vanguard drone ships may be included in the fleet.
rules.why: Enforced 9.9.2026 (item 8): the rule read from the book was added to build_data.py's RULE_PICKS table; resolveFleet checks it. conditional_cap: without a hive ship, anything other than Kraken/Vanguard (CAPITAL SHIPS too) = 0. The earlier gap: a conditional ban: 'if X, then only Y'. The engine had no conditional rule type.

rules.key: at least six escort drones for every hive ship
rules.text: The fleet must have at least six escort drones for every hive ship in the fleet.
rules.why: Enforced 9.9.2026 (item 8): the rule read from the book was added to build_data.py's RULE_PICKS table; resolveFleet checks it. The earlier gap: a ratio as a MINIMUM, like the Dark Eldar escort limit. The engine enforced only maximums.

rules.text: Tyranid Escorts come as squadrons of 1 to 12 vessels, while all other types are individuals and may not deploy in squadrons.
rules.why: Written by hand for the same reason as on the Vanguard list: the separator is the word 'to', and the sentence is in the SQUADRONS section, which has no ships.

rules.text: Up to 10 % of the fleet's points allowance may be spent on Ordnance markers as long as at least one hive ship is chosen.
rules.why: Enforced 9.9.2026 (item 8): the rule read from the book was added to build_data.py's RULE_PICKS table; resolveFleet checks it. points_share of=limit, cond: at least one hive ship. The earlier gap: a percentage share of the fleet's points limit, and a condition too ('as long as at least one hive ship'). Neither could be expressed. The ordnance markers are list rows with pric

rules.key: the points cost indicated provides you with one port weapon and one starboard weapon
rules.text: When buying 'port/starboard weapons' the points cost indicated provides you with one port weapon and one starboard weapon (of the same type) for the points cost indicated.
rules.why: An interpretation of the pricing: one purchase = both sides. The rows are in their own section 'Up to Three Port/Starboard Weapons'.

rules.key: No hive ship may ever have more than three different special refits
rules.text: No hive ship may ever have more than three different special refits, no cruiser more than two and no escort more than one.
rules.why: Enforced 9.9.2026 (item 8): the rule read from the book was added to build_data.py's RULE_PICKS table; resolveFleet checks it. unit_upgrade_max: BIO-ENHANCEMENTS rows per unit: hive ship 3, cruiser 2, escort 1 (three rules). The earlier gap: the bio-enhancements' count limit by ship type. The app does not count how many different refits one ship has, so the limit is left to the player. It reads BIO-ENHANCEME

rules.key: no single bio-enhancement may be granted more than once
rules.text: With the exception of reinforced carapace and extra spore cysts, no single bio-enhancement may be granted more than once.
rules.why: The structure allows every row once; the exceptions (carapace and spore cysts several times) cannot be bought in v1 - repeatable list upgrades are a v1.1 feature (docs/history/registry/BACKLOG.md).

rules.key: Tyranids cannot use the torpedo refits available to other races
rules.text: Because the equivalent of Tyranid torpedoes are always boarding torpedoes, Tyranids cannot use the torpedo refits available to other races.
rules.why: The ban concerns other factions' refit tables, which this list does not offer at all.

notes: The hive ship's and the cruiser's weapons are in three blocks in the book: 'One prow weapon', 'One thorax weapon' and 'Up to Three (or two) Port/Starboard Weapons'. The last two merged into one until 7.9.2026, because a section heading was not allowed to contain a slash. After the merge the duplicate pruning dropped 'Bio-plasma discharge +20' and 'Launch bays +20' from the hive ship, so two of the three port/starboard alternatives disappeared entirely.

The ESCORTS section has three ships in a row, each with its own weapon list. All three have 'Feeder tentacles +5', and the pruning dropped the two latter ones - the Escort drone and the Kraken lost the alternative. Fixed by resetting the pruning's memory at every ship row.
The weapons exclude each other one ship at a time: the Kraken's choice does not switch off the Escort drone's weapon, although they are in the same section.

This is the most complex list in the book. Two rules could be enforced (the hull ship ratio and the skwadron size); five are left as gaps, and the most important of them is the escorts' 6-12 per hive ship.
The Kraken's torpedo row is 'Boarding torpedoes' (+15) on this list and 'Torpedoes' (+15) on the Vanguard list. The difference is the book's own.

This list revealed a wide gap: the faction's shared rules (for the tyranids pages 425-428) showed only on each faction's FIRST list, because the book prints them once before it. Twenty lists of 32 were without - the Hive Fleet included. Now a list inherits the block from the previous list, and this reference checks the inheritance: three bio-enhancement rules are read from page 426, which is not in this list's own page range.
